about: Plain-worded twin messages for the router-widening bench (2026-10-12). One message for each twin of 76 of round 3's 145 pairs, neither naming the other twin. Written once, for Kevin's review; never trained on. Scored by whether the router lists BOTH twins for the message (co-listing) and whether it lists the wanted one.
